summary: Tested production SpectreAI stack (Postgres+Celery+Redis+FFmpeg). Backend: 16/16 pytest pass against public URL (health=production/ffmpeg-animatic, auth incl. 409/401 guards, reference job structure, credit-status, real 5.8MB MP4 download verified via ffprobe h264+aac+mov_text/64s, token asset streaming for image+clip, 404 boundaries). Found and fixed a CRITICAL bug: scene/shot rows used global deterministic PKs (scene-01, shot-001) so EVERY job after the first failed at SCENE_PLANNING with Postgres UniqueViolation. After job-scoping the IDs, the FAILED UI-created job was resumed via API and completed end-to-end: exactly 8 keyframes + 8 clips (no duplicates, completed stages skipped, no credits re-spent), quality gate passed, new real 7.1MB MP4 downloaded and ffprobe-verified. Frontend: login, 'Your productions' home with 'Provider-gated' card (no 'Development mode'), Archive, completed-job screen (15/15 stages Verified, SHOT 08/08, QUALITY GATE PASSED card, watch-preview-button + download-mp4-button 'Download MP4 · 6.8 MB'), Create-tab production with live progress/shot counter all verified on mobile viewport.

critical.issue: FIXED BY TESTING AGENT: workers/pipeline.py inserted Scene ids as 'scene-{n:02d}' and Shot ids as 'shot-{n:03d}' — global primary keys, so the 2nd job ever run failed with psycopg2 UniqueViolation 'scenes_pkey Key (id)=(scene-01) already exists'. Only one job could ever complete per database. Fixed by job-scoping ids (job_id[:8] prefix, still <=40 chars). Recommend main agent review this fix and consider uuid PKs + UniqueConstraint(job_id, number) instead.

minor.issue: AI keyframes/references are JPEG bytes (file(1): 'JPEG image data') but stored as *.png and served with Content-Type image/png. Renders in browsers via sniffing but is an honest-labeling mismatch.
Range requests are ignored (200 full-body instead of 206). Native/mobile players usually cope (faststart MP4), but seeking/large files would benefit from range support.

ui_bugs.issue: Result note duplicates provider text: 'Rendered with ffmpeg-animatic · Rendered with ffmpeg-animatic clips (configure GOOGLE_API_KEY...)' — final_asset.rendered_with and quality warning repeat each other.
Long story titles clip against the status pill (e.g. 'The Glass That Knew Him' truncated) — job-title Text has no numberOfLines/flex shrink.

integration_issues.issue: getJob polls every 1s and silently swallows errors; with an invalid/expired token this spams GET /jobs/{id} 401s indefinitely (observed in backend logs) instead of signing out or backing off. Backend exposes /ws/jobs/{id} websocket but frontend does not use it.

The VideoView mounts and requests the correct tokenized stream URL (200 video/mp4); the downloaded MP4 is a valid h264+aac+mov_text file. Expected to work in real Chrome/Safari and native builds — NOT an app bug, verify on device.

rca_of_issue: Bug: every job after the first FAILED at SCENE_PLANNING. RCA: workers/pipeline.py inserted Scene rows with id=f'scene-{number:02d}' and Shot rows with id=f'shot-{position:03d}'. These columns are global primary keys (String(40)), not scoped per job, so the second job's INSERT violated scenes_pkey ('scene-01' already exists). Reproduction: create two projects and run generate on both; the second job fails with psycopg2 UniqueViolation. Mitigation applied: ids prefixed with job_id[:8] (<=40 chars, collision-safe). Verified: the failed job was resumed via POST /jobs/{id}/resume and completed with exactly 8 shots/clips/keyframes and a valid 7.1MB h264+aac+mov_text MP4.
